messages:
jess: anyone else seeing a weird quota bump for streaming requests after the new proxy rollout?
Sam: saw it on a handful of customers this morning, looked like streaming tokens counted twice in some traces :thinking: 
kate: got an example?
jess: small snippet from customer logs — they connect -> proxy holds socket open for subtle 'trickle' writes, client reconnects after an intermittent network blip and the router charges both paths.
Sam: exact problem is proxy keeps the stream 'alive' and emits keepalives; when client reconnects we treat new session as fresh tokens and we don't reconcile held provisional tokens on the old ephemeral session.
kate: do we have session affinity or resume id in headers?
matt: we added X-Resume-Session but the proxy strips it in some cases. example headers from the proxy trace: 
```
> GET /v1/stream
> Host: api.redwood
> X-Resume-Session: 9f4b2a
> Connection: keep-alive
> Transfer-Encoding: chunked
> Proxy-Trickle: true
```

jess: the held-open connection emits periodic chunked heartbeats that our stream-meter sees as tokens (prefix bytes), but when the client reconnects and resumes we create a new toolcall+stream record and bill provisional tokens again.
Sam: that matches the billing anomalies — two provisional ledgers for one logical user request.
Kate: quick mitigation options?
matt: we can either 1) teach router to dedupe by X-Resume-Session when present, 2) mark proxy-trickle streams as 'non-billable keepalive' server-side, or 3) console-level fix: show a 'held-open session' indicator and a manual reconcile flow for ops.
Sam: option 1 is safest long-term but brittle if proxy continues stripping the header. we should also detect identical prefixes on reconnects as fallback.
jess: agree. we also need to avoid blocking emergency rollbacks. can we add a provisional TTL that expires held-open credits after N seconds and only convert to confirmed on final EOF?
matt: we already have provisional->confirmed flow but TTL is too short for some shaky mobile networks. increasing TTL will raise provisional exposure. tradeoff.
Kate: for the console UX: add a small dashboard tile in per-route billing that surfaces 'provisional held sessions' and a timeseries for 'reconciled vs orphaned credits'. ops love to slice by route/model.
Sam: +1. also add an annotation in the trace for 'proxy-trickle detected' so SREs can filter.
Jess: quick action items: 1) matt/infra patch to preserve X-Resume-Session through proxy (hotfix) 2) eng-platform to add dedupe-by-resume-id in router (canary) 3) product/devex to add console widget and alerting for held-open provisional credits.
matt: I can push proxy change today, will post deploy-bot when done.
deploy-bot: deploy: proxy-hotfix/keep-resume-header -> prod started by matt (pushed at 1758812560) :rocket:
Kate: after proxy patch, we should run a reconciliation job to void duplicate provisional charges for last 24h where resume id matches and client IPs match. careful with privacy and PII.
Sam: reconcile job should write a ReconciliationEvent to ledger so billing team has an audit trail.
Jess: agreed. last thought: consider a small protocol change — add X-Stream-Checksum on initial request so we can deterministically match resumed streams even if resume-id stripped. but that needs client SDK updates.
matt: noted. I'll implement header passthrough and post a canary plan.
Kate: I'll draft console mockups for the tile and ops flow.
Jess: thanks all. if anyone sees further spikes drop them here and include a trace id.
Sam: posted a sample trace id: trace_2026-03-21_abc123 for the one we were debugging.
Kate: thanks — tracking in the rollout doc. :thumbsup:
